verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents official server-side SDKs (e.g. @airwallex/node-sdk, TypeScript-first, strongly typed, error handling, retries, token refresh) plus a CLI, webhooks, and scoped API keys, giving AI-native developers concrete building blocks. However the SDKs are explicitly labeled beta and evidence only names a Node.js SDK, with no clear multi-language SDK coverage or independent/hands-on validation. Missing for 10: broader language SDK coverage beyond Node.js, confirmation the SDKs are GA (not beta), and independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
